race.comment: VIRTUAL ILLUSION (6) is the bookies' pin-up with back-to-back defeats as odds-on favourite. Didn't get a clean start and was behind the eight-ball thereafter last start when midfield over 1250m at the Parks track. Rock hard fit and the SP profile is hard to ignore. Ready to win. ANOTHERHOUSE (1) opened this prep with a couple of wins then tackled a BM86 over 1250m at the Parks circuit a fortnight ago and found that grade beyond him. Has three wins and two placings from five runs here at the trip. Back in grade and looms as a significant threat. EXTRA FLING (13) started at $2.10 but after racing on the speed didn't finish off as hoped over this course and distance a fortnight ago. Lightly raced four-year-old who can improve at the third run of the campaign. RAMASIS (8) was too bad to be true over 1050m here last start. Has raced once at 1200m and was successful she give him the benefit of the doubt. DELIGHTFUL SHECKY (2) draws a wide gate but has returned in good order this prep.
